evaluation.generated_sql: SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last,               SUM(s.salary) AS total_salary,               SUM(pav.points_won) AS total_points_won,               SUM(hf.votes) AS total_votes_hof       FROM thehistoryofbaseball_player p       JOIN thehistoryofbaseball_salary s ON p.player_id = s.player_id       JOIN thehistoryofbaseball_player_award_vote pav ON p.player_id = pav.player_id       JOIN thehistoryofbaseball_hall_of_fame hf ON p.player_id = hf.player_id AND hf.yearid = 1936 AND LOWER(hf.votedby) = 'bbwaa' AND LOWER(hf.category) = 'player'       WHERE (LOWER(p.name_first) = 'ty' AND LOWER(p.name_last) = 'cobb')          OR (LOWER(p.name_first) = 'babe' AND LOWER(p.name_last) = 'ruth')          OR (LOWER(p.name_first) = 'honus' AND LOWER(p.name_last) = 'wagner')          OR (LOWER(p.name_first) = 'christy' AND LOWER(p.name_last) = 'mathewson')          OR (LOWER(p.name_first) = 'walter' AND LOWER(p.name_last) = 'johnson')       GROUP BY p.name_first, p.name_last
